title: Locomotion Settings Bridge and Persistence
description:
Purpose: Provide a thin settings bridge so pressing X (Left) opens a wrist menu page (served by the hud_wrist_menu mechanic) where the player can switch locomotion style among Teleport, Smooth (head-relative), and Smooth (controller-relative), select Snap Turn vs Smooth Turn angle/speed, and toggle Comfort Vignette. Changes apply immediately and persist via save_load_system.

Behaviour:
- When X (Left) is pressed, hud_wrist_menu opens panels. This mechanic exposes a Settings provider and applies choices to the active built-ins:
  - Modes exposed: teleport, slide_head, slide_controller.
  - Turn: snap (degrees, cooldown) or smooth (exposed by hud, but if smooth turn is chosen the mechanic disables builtin snap and publishes a desired yaw rate consumed by ground_sprint_collision_guard for optional blending).
  - Comfort: vignette toggle flag and intensity scalar (0..1) published.
- Immediate apply: on selection, this mechanic enables exactly one of the following built-ins globally:
  - builtin.locomotion.teleport
  - builtin.locomotion.slide.head_relative
  - builtin.locomotion.slide.controller_relative
  And ensures builtin.locomotion.snap_turn stays enabled when Turn=Snap, disabled when Turn=Smooth.
- Persistence: writes keys via save_load_system (see Integration) whenever a setting changes.

Quest 3 bindings this mechanic expects via CMechanicBinding::Entry::params_json:
- params.value("open_menu_button", "X_left") — default "X_left". Note: The visual panel is implemented by hud_wrist_menu; this mechanic only exposes settings and applies them.
- params.value("default_mode", "slide_head"). Valid: "teleport" | "slide_head" | "slide_controller".
- params.value("default_snap_deg", 45.0)
- params.value("default_snap_cooldown_s", 0.30)
- params.value("default_vignette", true)

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding for input.
- Writes a global CLocomotionSettings singleton (struct with fields: mode, snap_degrees, snap_cooldown_s, vignette_enabled, vignette_intensity, smooth_turn_enabled, smooth_turn_rate_dps) stored on a service entity tagged CTag{ "locomotion_settings" }.
- Writes/reads from a CSavedSettings blob (owned by save_load_system) with keys: locomotion.mode, locomotion.snap_deg, locomotion.snap_cd, locomotion.smooth_turn_rate, locomotion.vignette.

Comfort/safety:
- Enforces only one locomotion style enabled at a time.
- If player is in an unsafe state (mid-air boost in flight_mode_mechanic), defer apply until B (Right) quick brake or altitude < 0.5 m over ground.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_locomotion_menu: toggling any setting updates the global CLocomotionSettings immediately and persists; re-opening the wrist menu shows the last chosen values.

Integration points:
- With builtin locomotion items: This mechanic enables/disables built-ins by setting a runtime tag on their bindings (e.g., enable flags on mechanics registered as locomotion_teleport, locomotion_slide_head, locomotion_slide_controller, locomotion_snap_turn) instead of unregistering.
- With save_load_system: Uses API channel "settings.set" and "settings.get"; keys under namespace "locomotion.*".
- With hud_wrist_menu (depends_on in that task): hud reads and writes CLocomotionSettings via messages provided by this mechanic: "locomotion.get_settings", "locomotion.apply_settings".

Assets/scenes: Active globally in all playable scenes listed in BuildSpec; no direct asset references.

Suggested file split: locomotion_settings_menu_register.cpp, locomotion_settings_menu_apply.cpp, locomotion_settings_menu_persist.cpp
